title: Pontotoc City schools seek feedback on student-success scorecard
excerpt: Pontotoc City School District seeks community input on a proposed scorecard covering academic, career and life readiness. Its notice links to a public survey.
locality: Pontotoc City School District, Pontotoc, Mississippi. The shared survey also lists Pontotoc County among participating North Mississippi school districts.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc City School District is seeking community feedback on a proposed Community-Based Improvement Scorecard intended to give families and communities a broader picture of student success.

The district is working with other North Mississippi school districts and the CREATE Foundation. The proposed scorecard covers academic readiness, career readiness and life readiness, according to the district’s notice.

The notice asks participants to review the proposed measures and answer five short questions about which measures matter most, whether any should be removed or combined, and what may be missing. The district notice and its linked public survey are available in the sources below.
